messages:
Maya (AE): FYI GreenHeart Systems sent an RFI asking for a capability matrix, KMS/HSM specifics, EU data residency mapping, a POC timeline, and pricing options. Legal also requested SOC2 evidence and encryption details. Who can help?
Ibrahim (SE): I can draft the capability matrix and KMS section. Quick Q: do they need an on-prem control plane or is VPC with dedicated tenancy acceptable? Also need target qps for embeddings/chat.
Maya (AE): They prefer on-prem but will accept VPC with strict tenancy/isolation. Targets: 150 qps embeddings, 40 qps chat, P50 <130ms.
Jo (Solutions Eng): Starting RFI answers doc and a 4-week POC plan (wk1: connectivity & auth + KMS setup; wk2: ingest & embedding accuracy; wk3: throughput testing; wk4: security review + handoff).
files-bot: uploaded greenheart_capmatrix_v1.pdf to thread  https://files.redwood/greenheart_capmatrix_v1.pdf
Ibrahim (SE): KMS note: customer-managed keys supported; optional HSM wrapping (cloud HSM or customer on-prem HSM); envelope encryption; rotation options via API. Will attach kms_summary.txt.
Jo (Solutions Eng): Security asked about FedRAMP. We are not certified. Propose a FedRAMP roadmap (9-12 months) plus compensating controls: private VPC deployment, continuous audit logs, SSP checklist and interim pen-testing report.
Ravi (Finance): For pricing propose two options: (A) 3-month dedicated reserved commit with capacity SLA; (B) hosted evaluation with burst support (pay-as-you-go). Send expected token/embedding volumes and Ill model both. Note: embedding quantization can reduce unit cost ~25%.
Maya (AE): Next steps: Ibrahim attach KMS + cap matrix, Jo finish RFI answers + POC runbook, Ravi produce pricing models. Aim to send RFI packet by EOD Friday. Flag any blocker here (EU data mapping, HSM certs).
Jo (Solutions Eng): Ack. I'll request SOC2 attestation PDF from Legal and confirm whether GreenHeart can provide a sample dataset for accuracy tests.
Ibrahim (SE): Uploaded kms_summary.txt and poc_runbook_v1.md  https://files.redwood/kms_summary.txt
Maya (AE): Thanks team  will consolidate and send to procurement. If GreenHeart insists on vendor-specific HSM certificates, that might need partner coordination.
Ravi (Finance): I'll have pricing scenarios by tomorrow afternoon.
Maya (AE): Perfect, keeping this thread active. :rocket:
